CMFT.description: Equivalent Moment Correction Factor Cm (CMFT). Fields set the auto-calculate flag and the manual major/minor axis moment correction factors Cmy and Cmz.

OPT_AUTO.description: Auto Calculate flag. When true the program computes Cm automatically; when false the CMY and CMZ values are used.

CMY.description: Equivalent moment correction factor Cmy about the major axis. Must satisfy 0.0 <= value <= 1.0 (handler throws otherwise).

CMZ.description: Equivalent moment correction factor Cmz about the minor axis. Must satisfy 0.0 <= value <= 1.0 (handler throws otherwise).
